## Purpose
The prerequisite item model and its vocabulary.

## Responsibilities
- **Vocabulary:**
  - `CATEGORIES` are credential, endpoint, configuration and information. `VAULT_CATEGORIES` are the first three;
  - `STATUSES` are pending, vault, environment, answered (information only), skipped and deferred;
  - `METADATA_KEY = "build_prerequisites"`.
- **`PrereqItem`** is a dataclass with: key, category, label, service, why, name (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE), secret_kind, sensitive, required, format_hint, alternative, default, used_by, candidates, status, auto, secret_id, secret_name, value and instruction.
  - Properties: `in_vault` and `settled`.
  - Methods: `as_dict()`, `public()` (which never includes the value of a vault-category item) and `from_dict()`.
- **`summary(items)`** counts the items by status.

## Key elements
`PrereqItem`, `summary`, `METADATA_KEY`, `CATEGORIES`, `STATUSES`.

## Nuances and gotchas
